evals.prompt: Did the AYMG v17 contract push work for UAMS recExample0000152? I just ran it through. Walk me through what fired and where it might have broken — pull current state, diff against expected outcomes, give me a verdict.
evals.expected_output: Triggers workflow-eval. Phase 1 inventory reads the v17 push script + existing audit output for appExample0000153. Phase 2 proposes cases including UAMS happy path, no-Advertiser red path, item-ref-202 error path, and idempotency. Phase 3 instructs user to snapshot via eval_helper.py before/after the trigger. evals.prompt: Regression-test the EA applicant-to-training FK match script before I --apply. 27 staged links from today's dry-run, I want to know they all land correctly without breaking the existing applicant records that already have training history.
evals.expected_output: Triggers workflow-eval. Phase 1 reads link_clean_matches_2026_06_05.py. Phase 2 proposes happy-path case (27 matches link to correct Applicants), idempotency case (re-running --apply is a no-op), reverse case (applicants outside the 27 are untouched), and edge case (any applicant with empty (first, last) is not matched). Phase 3 directs snapshot of Applicants and Training Tracker tables. Phase 4 produces verdict.

evals.prompt: Validate the CC enrollment automation end-to-end — Janine reports it's flaky. Some students get the welcome email, some don't. Need to figure out which step in the chain is breaking and for which subset of students.
evals.expected_output: Triggers workflow-eval. Phase 1 inventory identifies the chain (Gravity Forms submission → Airtable record create → Caseworker linking automation → Cohort assignment → welcome email). Phase 2 proposes cases that cover the suspected failure paths: missing Caseworker link, missing Cohort link, missing email field, manual-intervention-required records. Phase 3 walks user through pulling pre and post state for the last N enrollments. Phase 4 produces verdict identifying which step or which input shape produces the silent failures.
